name: Gwyneira
summary: Gwyneira is distinguished by its soft bounce fabric that lends both texture and comfort to its flowing silhouette. The design rests on a smooth round base, a sculptural foundation that adds balance and modern refinement. With its gentle curves and inviting presence, it brings a sense of serene elegance and timeless charm to contemporary interiors. 55x62x84
